title: Riccati--Gamma Dynamics for Concavity and Asymptotics of Generalized Dirichlet Eta Functions
summary: We develop a unified analytical and dynamical framework for the qualitative study of the one-parameter family of generalized Dirichlet eta functions $η_{a}(t)=\sum_{m\ge0}(-1)^{m}(am+1)^{-t}$, $a>0$, $t>0$, which includes the classical Dirichlet eta and beta functions. Using a Mellin--Laplace representation of $η_{a}$ as $\mathbb{E}[f_{a}(X_{t})]$, where $f_{a}$ is a scaled logistic function and $(X_{t})$ a standard Gamma process, we show that the logarithmic derivative $\varphi_{a}(t)=η_{a}'(t)/η_{a}(t)$ satisfies a non-homogeneous Riccati equation with strictly negative forcing.
